title: Mac and Cheese
subtitle: Baked macaroni in a sharp cheddar sauce
excerpt: A proper baked mac and cheese with a thick, creamy cheese sauce made from scratch and a crisp breadcrumb crust on top. Use macaroni shapes so the sauce gets trapped inside each tube. It feeds four comfortably and reheats well the next day.
sourceNotes: Based on the American baked mac and cheese tradition, made with a classic bechamel-style roux as the sauce base.

recipe.freezeNotes: Freeze before baking. Defrost overnight in the fridge, then bake as directed.
recipe.batchNotes: Doubles well. Use a larger baking dish.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Assemble up to the point of baking, cover and refrigerate for up to 1 day. Add 10 minutes to the bake time from cold.

content.text: Use macaroni or another short pasta shape with holes or ridges so the sauce clings and fills each piece. Cook the pasta until just underdone before baking; it will finish cooking in the oven and absorb some of the sauce.
Preheat the oven to 200C. Cook the pasta in well-salted boiling water for 2 minutes less than the packet says. Drain and set aside.
Melt the butter in a large saucepan over a medium heat. Add the flour and stir for 2 minutes until it forms a paste and smells slightly nutty.
Pour in the milk a little at a time, whisking continuously to avoid lumps, until all the milk is incorporated and the sauce is smooth.
Simmer the sauce for 5 minutes, stirring often, until it thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon.
Remove from the heat and stir in 200g of the grated cheddar and the mustard. Season with salt and black pepper.
Add the drained pasta and stir to coat. Transfer to a baking dish.
Scatter the remaining cheddar and the panko breadcrumbs over the top. Bake for 20 minutes until golden and bubbling.

items.fix: Whisk hard and keep adding milk slowly; heat will smooth it out.

items.cause: Oven not hot enough or dish placed too low
items.fix: Move dish to the top shelf for the last 5 minutes.

items.cause: Baked too long without a lid
items.fix: Cover loosely with foil and bake for the first 15 minutes.
